blocks.text: ILOILO CITY — Motorists lined up at gasoline stations in Iloilo City on Monday evening, Sept. 21, ahead of a steep pump price increase taking effect Tuesday. Oil companies announced increases of P8.82 per liter for diesel, P6.47 for kerosene and P4.88 for gasoline. READ: Shell Pilipinas staggers hikes; diesel surges over P8/liter The latest hike marks the third straight week of major fuel price increases. Since the start of September, diesel prices will have risen by P18.31 per liter, while gasoline will have increased by P15.25 and kerosene by P16.67.
